8240.title: Native skill attachment transport investigation
8240.rootCauseOneLine: No loss reproduced: bb preserved native-command image payloads at the ACP transport boundary; the reported downstream loss remains unlocalized.
8240.proposedFix: Capture both bb outbound ACP blocks and provider downstream blocks on the affected platform before proposing a fix.
8240.caveats: Linux deterministic ACP peer only; actual Windows/Kimi skill processing was not exercised. Low confidence in the unknown reported root cause, high confidence in the measured payload preservation.
